result.description: identical_adopted: a configuration candidate equal in effect to the version in force (no new version); kept: the config_drift condition resolved keep (no new version); refused: the position rule or an invariant refused the version (reason in cause).

version.description: The composed version; null unless result == composed.

gate.description: fallback: the gate or condition whose exhaustion took the fallback.

fallback_cause.description: fallback: the gap cause of the fallback (Gap Record, cause); deliverable_removed is no fallback, its re-planning composes a replan version.

replan_id.description: replan: the re-planning whose revision composed the version.

diff_summary.description: The composed version relative to the previous version: pruned elements added and removed, ceilings changed, gates waived and unwaived. The member is present only on a line with result == composed: null for version 1, the summary for a later version; every other line omits it.

pruned_added.description: Pruned in this version, not in the previous one (element, id, reason, source_fact).

pruned_removed.description: Pruned in the previous version, not in this one (element, id, reason, source_fact).

call_site.description: state_id of the calling state of the policy call.

argument.description: The bound argument whose value changed (retry_budget, fix_budget, actions).

previous.description: The value in the previous version; null where the previous version did not bind the argument.

value.description: The value in this version; null where this version does not bind the argument.

gates_waived.description: Waived in this version, not in the previous one (gate, waiver_id).

gates_unwaived.description: Waived in the previous version, not in this one (gate, waiver_id).
